name: vLLM#52617: LMCache P/D receiver reports full hit but decoding diverges
notes: LMCache P/D receiver reports complete KV-cache hit but decoding diverges from monolithic baseline at token 0. First generated token differs, complete output differs, logprob differences reach 2.58-3.61. NIXL and Mooncake connectors work correctly. Demonstrates KV cache corruption in disaggregated serving.
